easy.def: To throw or move things all over.
easy.example: We scatter seeds for the birds.

more.def: To throw or spread things over a wide area, or to move apart quickly.
more.example: The marbles scattered across the floor when the bag broke.

easy.def: One of the four parts of the year.

more.def: One of the four parts of the year: spring, summer, fall, and winter.
more.example: Fall is my favorite season because the leaves change color.

easy.def: Something you do not tell other people.

more.def: Something that is kept hidden or known by only a few people.
more.example: She kept the surprise party a secret for two weeks.

easy.example: It is selfish not to share.

more.def: Caring only about yourself and not about other people.
more.example: It was selfish of him to eat the whole cake without sharing.

easy.def: A dark shape made when something blocks the light.
easy.example: I can see my shadow on the wall.

more.def: A dark shape that forms when something blocks light.
more.example: In the evening, the trees cast long shadows across the lawn.

easy.example: We found shelter from the rain.

more.def: A place that covers and protects people or animals from weather or danger.
more.example: The hikers built a shelter out of branches before the storm.

easy.def: To shake because you are cold or scared.

more.def: To shake slightly because you are cold or frightened.
more.example: We shivered at the bus stop in the icy wind.

easy.example: The house was silent at night.

more.example: The forest was silent after the snowfall.

easy.example: Our shoes are similar. They are both blue.

more.def: Alike in many ways, but not exactly the same.
more.example: A wolf looks similar to a large dog.

more.def: Easy to understand or do; not hard or complicated.
more.example: The directions were simple, so we finished quickly.

easy.def: All the bones in a body.

more.def: The frame of bones that supports the body of a person or animal.
more.example: The museum has the skeleton of a huge dinosaur.

easy.def: So wet or smooth that you might slide.

more.def: So smooth, wet, or icy that it is hard to hold or walk on.
more.example: Be careful, because the floor is slippery when it is wet.

easy.def: A way to fix a problem.
easy.example: I found a solution. We can share the toy!

more.def: The answer to a problem or the way to fix it.
more.example: The solution to the puzzle was hidden in the last clue.

more.def: Firm and not shaking; also, not changing much.
more.example: She kept a steady hand while she painted the tiny flowers.

more.def: Unusual, odd, or not known to you.
more.example: A strange light was blinking in the sky.

easy.def: Not wanting to change your mind.
easy.example: The stubborn puppy would not come inside.

more.def: Refusing to change your mind or do what others want.
more.example: He was too stubborn to admit that he was lost.

easy.def: Something you did not know would happen.

more.def: Something that happens that you did not expect.
more.example: It was a nice surprise to find a letter in the mailbox.

more.def: To stay alive, especially through something hard or dangerous.
more.example: Camels can survive for days without drinking water.
